NBA DFS Picks for Thursday, November 5 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, November 5 · 2 games · First game 9:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 5, 4:10 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Thursday, November 5 DraftKings main slate at 54.5 DraftKings points for $11,000. Stephen Curry (GSW, 43.8, $8,200) and Franz Wagner (ORL, 42.9, $8,700) are next.

Stephen Curry (GSW) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.34 projected points per $1,000 at $8,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 5, 4:10 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
